comparison.objective: Distribute six oranges between two trays so Maya and Leo receive equal final shares given Leo's initial two; candidate finishes threaded inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Count, reason about allocation, and transport fruit versus precision impact-tool manipulation and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Maya receives three added oranges and Leo one, yielding fair totals, versus four tangs fractured and deposited without damage.
comparison.reason: Fair allocation and bulk pick-and-place do not test tang fracture. Placement, damage, and scoring tolerances are not detailed.
